Summary: The Employment Situation report for October 2026 is scheduled to be released on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 08:30 a.m. (ET) according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. This release is part of the monthly Employment Situation Summary, which includes data on employment, unemployment, and labor market trends. The report is typically published on the first Friday of each month, unless a holiday or other reason necessitates a change in the release date.
